title.zh: 授予 Cauayan 电力公司在伊莎贝拉省 Cauayan 市镇经营电灯、热力与动力系统的特许权法案
title.en: An Act Granting Cauayan Electric Corporation a Franchise for An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Cauayan, Province of Isabela
title.orig: An Act Granting Cauayan Electric Corporation a Franchise for An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Cauayan, Province of Isabela
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Cauayan Electric Corporation để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Cauayan, tỉnh Isabela
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Cauayan Electric Corporation เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Cauayan, จังหวัด Isabela
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Cauayan Electric Corporation untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Cauayan, Provinsi Isabela
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Cauayan Electric Corporation untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Cauayan, Wilayah Isabela

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6459_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the provisions of the Constitutor and to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred thirty-two, there is granted to Cauayan Electric Corporation, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to install, operate and maintain an electric light, heat and power system for the Purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power for sale in the Municipality of Cauayan, Province of Isabela.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase secure from the National Power Corporation electric, heat and power, the National Power Corporation is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates.

It is expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the system and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender its franchise and will turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at fair market value, less reasonable depreciation.

In consideration of the franchise and rights hereby granted, the grantee shall pay a franchise tax equal to five per centum of the gross earnings under this franchise, three per centum of which shall accrue to the National Government and two per centum to the municipality where the franchise is being operated.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without executive approval, June 17, 1972.
